value.title: A Black Goblin Awakens
value.synopsis: On his way to a temple in the Japanese countryside, Kantaro discovers the resting place of the demon-eating goblin. Kantaro successfully releases the creature and names him Haruka, becoming his master. Together, they must hurry to save a young noble woman from a creature known as the Icicle Woman.

value.title: Yoshiwara`s Mystery
value.synopsis: Kantaro and Haruka travel to Yoshiwara to investigate odd happenings. While there, Kantaro befriends Kosume, a courtesan haunted by a dark secret.

value.title: Mountain Fairy Tale
value.synopsis: Kantaro’s band of supernatural adventurers head to the mountains for a vacation. The team springs into action when they discover the children of the village are disappearing. The disappearances are blamed on the region's God of the Mountain, and the group quickly departs to defeat him.

value.title: The Forbidden Portrait
value.synopsis: In the woods of Japan, a mysterious photographer traps the soul of the young women in pictures he takes of them. Kantaro’s search for the photographer becomes desperate when he traps Reiko’s soul in a portrait.

value.title: A Man who Dances in the Dark
value.synopsis: Kantaro returns home to visit and old friend, Yumeyako. However, Yumeyako’s client, the famous doll-maker Shinsuburo, has a dark secret; he wishes to transfer Yumeyako’s essence to one of his dolls.

value.title: The 9:07 PM Ghost Train
value.synopsis: Six months after a horrific accident, a ghost trolley appears in a small village. The supernatural detectives investigate and meet Nene, a young girl who may hold the secret to the mysterious ghost trolley.

value.title: Alluring Call
value.synopsis: When a daughter of a wealthy family disappears from Asakusa, Haruka and Kantaro are called into action. However, the two are constantly bickering, making it difficult to proceed with the case and discover the secret of Lord Katsuragi and the Katsuragi Society.

value.title: She Who Fascinates
value.synopsis: Yoko keeps the Ichinomiya household running. She cooks, cleans, and washes for Kantaro and the other monsters, with little reward. After Kantaro and Haruka devour a treat she was saving for later, Yoko decides to move out of the house.

value.title: Yome Island Mystery Ballade
value.synopsis: On Bride Island, people are turning into skeletons overnight. Professor Numata asks Kantaro and his college rival and supernatural skeptic Hasumi to investigate.

value.title: The Word of Wind - Part One
value.synopsis: In part one of a two-part adventure, Kantaro, Haruka, and the team attempt to solve the mysterious deaths on the eve of Suzuku Village’s Festival of the Wind.

value.title: The Word of Wind - Part Two
value.synopsis: In part two, Kantaro and Haruka discover the cause behind the mysterious deaths in Suzuku Village is closer to home than they feared.

value.title: Goblin and Roses
value.synopsis: After the female president of a trading company hires the team to solve her ghost problem, her gaze turns to Haruka. However, her intentions remain unclear.

value.title: The Nightmare in the Woodland
value.synopsis: An army unit disappears after their discovery of a missing battleship deep in the dense forest. Kantarou is hired to solve the mystery and encounter trap to ensnare Haruka.

value.title: A Woman who Loved Books
value.synopsis: Kantaro's editor, Reiko, becomes possessed after she is absorbed into an ancient book in the archives. The team’s tactics must be much more subtle in their tactics to save her.

value.title: Chorus of Cicadas at the Ending of Summer
value.synopsis: Suzu’s memories trigger a series of unusual events. As everyone disappears, Suzu must decide whether the world is truly reality or if she really is stuck inside a dream.

value.title: Ah, Married Couple`s Elegy
value.synopsis: Kantaro faces the spirit of a servant-girl-turned-mistress that haunts the home of her previous employers.

value.title: British Nymph
value.synopsis: A pretty little girl, Rosalie, visiting from England has strange connections to the local haunted church.

value.title: The Mystery Society
value.synopsis: Kantarou’s arch-rival, Hasumi, creates the Paranormal Research Society to prove through science that monsters do not exist.

value.title: Maple-Colored Love
value.synopsis: Yoko meets a new potential love interest and starts to work at his fabric shop. However, a spiritual presence at the shop will not allow Yoko to ruin tradition.

value.title: The Maiden Gidayu Ogre Recital
value.synopsis: Kantaro meets a folksinger who tells tales of a demon-eating goblin, and with it summons multiple demons that Haruka and Kantaro must face.

value.title: The Door of Memories
value.synopsis: A fun trip to the city takes a dangerous turn when possessed Rosalie unleashes the true goblin sealed within Haruka.

value.title: Blue Eyes
value.synopsis: With Haruka’s mind thrown into chaos, an ominous rift develops between Kantaro and the troubled demon eater.

value.title: Snow Scene of Glass
value.synopsis: Haruka’s sudden disappearance has everyone concerned. However, Kantaro search for his friend leads Yoko into a dangerous trap.

value.title: Hearts in the Distance
value.synopsis: The transformation of The Black Goblin is almost complete, leading to a brutal and shocking battle.

value.title: Invisible Strength
value.synopsis: A tragic passing and a dark secret both come to light as Haruka and Kantaro make the decision that decides their fates forever.
